title: Spend per passenger tier
statementMd:
Classify passengers by total fare spent: `bronze` under 1000, `silver` 1000 to under 3000, `gold` 3000 or more. Count passengers per tier.

Expected columns: `tier`, `passengers`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Aggregate per passenger in a subquery, then CASE.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN total < 1000 THEN 'bronze' WHEN total < 3000 THEN 'silver' ELSE 'gold' END AS tier, COUNT(*) AS passengers FROM (SELECT passenger, SUM(fare) AS total FROM bookings GROUP BY passenger) GROUP BY tier;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
